answer: A newcomer joins only through a sponsor who posts a bond that stays locked for the newcomer's first 30-epoch voyage. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, that bond burns, and a smaller slice of the sponsor's own sponsor burns too, so liability runs up the family tree like a crack through timber. A farm must then risk real, bonded ancestors for every fake head, and each abandoned sock puppet stays on-ledger as a costly relic of its lineage instead of a free throwaway.
